_readme: The links for every picture and film on the page. Edit this file and the
site changes. No rebuild, no code, no deploy of anything but this file:
it is fetched at runtime, so replacing it on the host is enough.
Keys are the filenames the placeholders already print on screen. Put a
URL against one and that slot stops being a placeholder and becomes the
a YouTube link   https://youtu.be/XYZ  or  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XYZ
or a /shorts/ link. Rendered as an embed.
for when the defaults below are wrong for that slot.
empty string     leaves the placeholder exactly as it is today.
Defaults: background slots autoplay muted and loop; anything else gets
ordinary controls. Set them explicitly with the object form if needed.
